---
name: Remove or correct an entry about my organisation
about: You are named in a claim shown on DarkLens and want it removed or corrected
labels: takedown
---

DarkLens repeats **public claims** made by third parties (see [data sources](../../docs/data-sources.md)). A claim is an accusation by criminals, not a confirmed breach.

**Which alert?** (link)

**Who are you, in relation to the organisation named?** (so we can act on a genuine request)

**What would you like done?** (remove it, add a note, correct a detail)

Please do not include credentials or leaked material.
